_provenance: The habitable zone as an EMERGENT climate architecture. The genome sets nebular delivery fractions and shortcut parameters; the objective verifies that the grown climate system produces oceans, atmospheres, interior gradients, and diversity — not by taste, by researched planetary-science anchors.

walls.has_ocean_worst: Every catalog system MUST have at least one ocean world. This is the human's bar: 'We know it works when oceans form.' Zero ocean worlds means the climate rung failed across the entire catalog.
walls.climate_classes_worst: The WORST system MUST span at least 3 distinct climate classes. The real solar system spans 6 (airless, frozen, ocean, hot-rock, runaway, giant); a catalog where every system is all-oceans or all-airless has no architecture — it found one number and copied it. 3 is the floor for 'diversity exists.'
walls.gradient_frac_worst: At least half of rocky planets must have an interior gradient above 500 K. A planet with no thermal gradient has no core — it is a dead rock, not a differentiated world. The human's third bar: 'a temperature gradient in the planet interior.'
walls.ocean_temp_mean: Ocean-world surface temperature MUST sit inside liquid water's window. Below 275 K the ocean freezes (it is ice, not ocean); above 370 K crosses the moist-greenhouse limit — stratospheric water photolyzes and hydrogen escapes. Venus is NOT an ocean world, and calling it one is wrong by physics, not by opinion.
walls.ocean_greenhouse_mean: The greenhouse effect on ocean worlds MUST be Earth-like. Below 15 K is a naked rock (like Mars today — no greenhouse to speak of); above 80 K is Venus territory. Earth's +33 K at 1 bar is the anchor; the band is wide because the catalog spans different stellar fluxes.
walls.runaway_frac_mean: Runaway-greenhouse planets MUST be a minority. Above 30% means the genome is cooking every atmosphere — the moist_limit is too permissive. A habitable zone dominated by steam pressure-cookers is not habitable.
